proposed.text: An architect certifies code compliance without the review needed to know whether the documents comply. Which source-backed conduct category is implicated?

options.text: No violation if the deadline was tight
Fraud/deceit, misrepresentation, gross negligence, or unprofessional conduct depending the facts
